title: Dendritic cell differentiation from monocytes
author: Girija Goyal
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xjrfkm6

steps.title: Plate monocytes with cytokines
steps.instruction: Plate 1 × 10⁶ monocytes per well in a 24‑well plate using 1 mL RPMI supplemented with 400 ng/mL GM‑CSF and 250 ng/mL IL‑4.

steps.title: Day 2‑3 non‑adherent cell assessment
steps.instruction: At 2 days (up to 3 days) after plating, examine each well for floating non‑adherent small cells (possible neutrophils or lymphocytes). If many are present, gently aspirate all media and add fresh RPMI containing 400 ng/mL GM‑CSF and 250 ng/mL IL‑4; if few, continue without media change.

substeps.instruction: Examine wells for floating non‑adherent cells
If many cells, aspirate all media and add fresh cytokine‑containing RPMI
If few cells, proceed to next step

steps.title: Half‑media change after day 5
steps.instruction: From day 5 onward, replace only half of the culture volume by gently aspirating from the top of each well and adding fresh RPMI with 400 ng/mL GM‑CSF and 250 ng/mL IL‑4.

steps.title: Harvest dendritic cells day 5+
steps.instruction: On day 5 or later, detach cells by pipetting repeatedly around each well, collect the suspended cells, and proceed to downstream applications.
